title: Total number of times I’ve done something
body: The only thing that would make HabitKit more perfect would be to be able to put how long you want to follow the habit and thus also be able to see in numbers how many you have completed compared to the total, please, the numerical data in the next update!🙏🏻
author: PerseveriaMP

title: One of the best apps of 2024
body: HabitKit is one of the most impressive habit-tracking apps I’ve used. The design is stunning, with a clean and intuitive interface that makes tracking habits simple and enjoyable. The attention to detail, especially the beautifully designed icons, is remarkable. It’s incredibly useful for staying consistent, with features that make organizing and customizing habits effortless. I also recommend the Premium version—it adds great value. HabitKit has become essential in my daily routine and is perfect for anyone serious about personal growth.
